text:
Ash K: Heads up — noticed a spike in console 'unknown route' attribution this morning after the TS/Go SDK shipped the header rename. Looks like our console mapping is failing to pick up route attrs.
Maria P: ugh. which header rename? the compact/encoding change?
Ash K: Yeah. old header: `X-Route-Meta: team=payments;priority=high` new header: `X-Route-Attrs: t=payments|p=h` — compact encoding landed in py/ts/go clients.
Samir R: That should have been a shim in the gateway tho. Did the proxy not normalize?
Maria P: Proxy had a quick normalize rule for legacy -> canonical, but it expects semicolons. The compact pipe format didn't match, so console ingestion treated it as opaque.
devex-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/proxy/pull/812 — add compact header normalizer (canary config).
DevEx Lead: Can we avoid forcing a console schema change? We want the SDKs to evolve but console UX shouldn't break.
Jonathan L: Quick proposal: 1) add gateway shim to canonicalize both formats 2) ingest both formats in console for 2 weeks 3) ship SDK docs and opt-in flag for compact mode
Samir R: +1. Also suggest telemetry flagging so we can count clients using compact format before we flip. Maybe emit `x-client-route-format: compact|legacy`.
Maria P: We already have limited telemetry fields in traces. Adding a `route_format` tag won't cost much. Console would show a small histogram.
Ash K: For rollout UX — ops wants a way to preview mappings before the rewrite. Can we add a console preview tile that shows: incoming header sample -> parsed attrs -> resolved route-id?
Jonathan L: doable — the preview tile can accept a sample header and show parsed output with warning if ambiguous. Good for canary testers.
DevEx Lead: Who will own the SDK opt-in flag backport? Py/TS need a minor release, Go maybe a patch.
Samir R: I'll coordinate. Plan: py/ts release tomorrow with `ROUTE_ATTRS=compact` opt-in env var; default remains legacy. Go maintainers will follow with patch.
Maria P: Ops action: enable gateway shim in canary region (us-west-2) after PR merges. Console team: add preview tile and ingestion fallback for two weeks.
Ash K: TL;DR: no breaking changes immediate — enable shim + telemetry + preview tile, SDKs opt-in only. I'll post a short status note in #release-war-room once gateway shim is rolling. :eyes:
DevEx Lead: Thanks — please add the rollout checklist to the PR.
Samir R: will do.
Maria P: FYI, I saw ~2.4% of traffic already using compact format (from prod traces). Good to know.
Ash K: Nice — that means opt-in path already has a few adopters.
Jonathan L: Ok — locking action items: Samir (SDKs), Maria (gateway shim + telemetry), DevEx (preview tile UX), Ash (release note).
Samir R: noted.
Ash K: thanks all :thumbsup:
